summary: Notion gives verified college/university students a free Education Plus plan (same as paid Plus: unlimited blocks and file uploads, 30-day version history, up to 10 guests) while enrolled via a school email recognised in the WHED. Stays active as long as the school email remains valid.
claim_steps: Sign up to Notion with your school email address.
Go to Settings → Upgrade plan → Get free Education plan.
If your school is recognised, you are upgraded to Plus automatically; otherwise email team@makenotion.com to allowlist your domain.

social_proof.title: Get the Education Plan for students & teachers
social_proof.text: The Education Plan for individual students and teachers is a free plan for a one-member workspace. It is available for students at accredited colleges and universities with a WHED school email.
